opening.argument: The title claims, “i have a clearly shown how i make two bnb in four hours,” while the description offers a bot download and says, “You can connect your Metamask / Bitcoin / TronLink / Exodus / etc. wallets.” Those representations pair rapid cryptocurrency returns with direct software access and wallet participation. The interface visibly includes a token or contract field, amount field, APPROVE control, and BUY, FAST CONTRACT & BUY, and SELL controls. A callout further links clicking BUY to a BUY transaction and describes the bot as fast. Together, these features create an apparent path from the promised benefit to trading software and wallet use. The available evidence does not establish that any transaction completed or that the advertised earnings occurred.
